Bahrain court rules for HDFC Bank in Credit Suisse AT1 bond dispute

A court in Bahrain has ruled in favor of HDFC Bank, dismissing claims brought by investors of Credit Suisse AT1 bonds. The investors had filed a case against HDFC Bank concerning these bonds. The Bahraini court's decision rejected the investors' claims, upholding HDFC Bank's position in the dispute.
